question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

SHALLOW
solution:
The correct answer is '**deep**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **shallow **means **off little depth**
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the antonyms:
 
• **wide**: of great or more than average width
 
• **deep**: extending far down from the top or surface
 
• **near**: at or to a short distance away
 
• **long**: measuring a great distance end to end

Hence, the antonym of **shallow **is **deep**

 
• **Example: ***The swimming pool was very **deep**__*.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] __Hinglish__** 

__
 
• **Shallow **शब्द का अर्थ है **उथला**
 
• आइए दिए गए विलोम का अर्थ देखें
 
• **wide **: चौड़ा
 
• **deep **: गहरा
 
• **near **: पास में
 
• **long **: लंबा

इसलिए **'shallow' **का विलोम **'deep' **है

 
• **Example**: *My friend had a **deep **__wound on his forehead from a childhood accident.*
